chunks: Some of them made a covenant with God: 'If You give us in Your bounty we shall give alms and be upright.'

key_terms.عَاهَدَ: made a covenant or solemn pledge

ai.seo_question: What covenant did the people make with God regarding wealth and charity?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is frequently cited to illustrate the conditional piety of the Hypocrites (Munafiqun), whose pledge of charity was motivated by worldly gain rather than sincere devotion. The covenant underscores the distinction between mere verbal commitment and the steadfastness required to truly belong among the 'righteous' (al-Salihin). This narrative serves as a cautionary example of how spiritual promises can be contingent upon immediate material benefit.
